name: jmpm-monorepo
description: Custom package manager and registry ecosystem in TypeScript & Node.js

scripts.build:registry: npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/shared && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/metadata && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/storage && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/registry-api
scripts.build: npm run build:registry && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/config && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/package-manifest && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/pack && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/cache && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/auth && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/registry-client && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/resolver && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/lockfile && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/installer && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/core && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/cli && npm run build --workspace=@jmpm/registry-web
